description: Meet the little black cardigan of cars: a sleek 2018 Honda Fit EX dressed in Black on the outside with a cozy Black cloth interior. It’s economical, clever, and surprisingly athletic for something that could double as a grocery-getter and a weekend escape artist. Under the hood you’ll find a 1.5L I4 that serves up 128 hp and 113 ft-lbs of torque — paired to Honda’s smooth CVT to keep things efficient and uneventful at the stoplight opera. The payoff? Real-world mileage that’ll make your wallet smile: about 31 MPG city and 36 MPG highway. Why this Fit EX is worth a look - Low miles, high value: Under 60,000 miles total, averaging less than 7,000 miles per year. That’s “well-kept commuter” kind of mileage. - Excellent overall condition: Clean, well-maintained, and ready for immediate enjoyment — without squeaks, surprises, or existential questions. Factory features you’ll actually use (and secretly enjoy) - Smart, efficient powertrain: 1.5L I4 engine with a CVT for relaxed, fuel-conscious driving. - Magic Seat versatility: Honda’s famous rear seats fold in multiple configurations (Utility, Long, Tall, and Normal) so you can carry tall plants, long lumber, or more groceries than you’d expect. - Infotainment made friendly: A factory touchscreen audio system with smartphone integration (Apple CarPlay and Android Auto), Bluetooth hands-free calling/streaming, and USB/Aux inputs so you can get directions, playlists, and podcast wisdom with minimal finger gymnastics. - Comfort and convenience: Black cloth seating that’s durable and easy to live with, power windows and locks, cruise control for highway naps (the safe kind), and steering-wheel audio controls so you can pretend to multitask like a pro. - Climate control: Efficient HVAC system to keep you cool in traffic and warm when the world conspires against your commute. - Safety essentials: Multi-angle rearview camera for parking karma, ABS, stability control, traction control, and a full complement of airbags — the sensible backup dancers for daily driving. - Exterior and wheels: Clean Black exterior that hides road grime like a pro and alloy wheels that keep the stance confident without trying too hard. Who this Fit is for - The city dweller who wants big cargo ideas in a compact package. - The commuter who appreciates great MPG and low running costs. - Anyone who enjoys the idea of a car that’s fun to fiddle with but not fussy to own. In short: if you want a reliable, economical, and unexpectedly practical little hatchback wrapped in stealthy black, this 2018 Honda Fit EX is like finding money in an old coat — pleasantly surprising and immediately useful. Interested? Come see it before someone else adopts this charmingly responsible little machine. CAR PLUS FINANCE 17281 Beach Boulevard Suite 102 Huntington Beach, CA 92647 (310) 539-2888

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics

Whether navigating city streets or exploring the outdoors, this Defender is built to stand out while offering the durability and capability that Land Rover is known for.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

Discover the pinnacle of capability and refined luxury in the 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 High Country. This exceptional full-size pickup is the embodiment of power, technology, and uncompromising craftsmanship, making it the perfect choice for discerning buyers seeking the ultimate in truck performance and premium amenities.

Boasting a stunning Iridescent Pearl Tricoat exterior and a wealth of premium features, this Silverado High Country stands out from the crowd. Key highlights include:

- ONE OWNER
- 3.0L I-6 Diesel Turbocharged (Duramax) engine with 305 hp and 495 lb-ft of torque
- High Capacity Suspension Package
- Preferred Equipment Group 3LZ
- Trailering Package
- Up-Level Rear Seat with Storage Package

Inside, you'll be surrounded by unparalleled comfort and convenience. Enjoy the luxurious perforated leather seating, heated and ventilated front seats, and a heated steering wheel. The Bose premium audio system and 12.3-inch reconfigurable digital display provide an immersive multimedia experience, while the suite of advanced safety technologies, including Adaptive Cruise Control and Rear Cross Traffic Braking, give you peace of mind on the road.

Designed to handle the most demanding tasks with ease, this Silverado High Country offers best-in-class towing and payload capabilities. The integrated trailer brake controller, hitch guidance with hitch view, and trailer camera provisions make towing a breeze. And with the available 4-wheel drive system, you can conquer any terrain with confidence.

Whether you're hauling heavy loads, traversing rugged landscapes, or simply seeking a premium driving experience, the 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 High Country is the ultimate choice. Schedule a test drive today and discover the power and refinement that this exceptional truck has to offer.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics

When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. Predictive brake assist helps see to it that you stop.
